sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Factions are organized groups active in the region. The most active forces in the Norvinsk region are two private military companies, hired by the sides of the initial conflict.

sections.heading: BEAR
sections.text:
BEAR
Allegedly created by a direct order of the Russian government, is employed by the Norvinsk region officials to uncover any evidence of the TerraGroup illicit activities.

sections.heading: USEC
sections.text:
USEC
Employed by notorious TerraGroup international corporation, vigorously engages in armed clashes, hindering the investigation of TerraGroup activities, carried on by local authorities. Moreover, according to intelligence agencies, USEC provides armed cover to illegal work and research of the foreign company.

sections.heading: Scavs
sections.text:
Scavs
Civilians, gang members, and other miscreants who have taken up arms to carve out a niche for themselves in the war-torn Tarkov. Untrained, poorly equipped, they are nonetheless numerous and a significant threat to anyone who stands in their way.

sections.heading: Scav Raiders
sections.text: Scav RaidersShady group of armed people, according to rumors, consisting of former PMC operators, local residents and others with obvious combat and tactical training.

sections.heading: Rogues
sections.text:
Rogues
Rogues are ex-USEC operatives, led and commanded by the Goons.

sections.heading: Cultists
sections.text:
Cultists
A cult of mysterious people who keep to tall grass and dark shadows, they try to sneak up behind the enemy and attack them with a poisoned sacrificial knife. Their motives are still unknown, but they believe in an upcoming cataclysm. They have several ritual spots across Tarkov, for example in Customs, Woods and Shoreline. They offer weapons in sacrifice.

sections.heading: RUAF
sections.text:
RUAF
The Russian Armed Forces are stationed around the Norvinsk region, alongside UN peacekeepers, to enforce a blockade of the territory.

sections.heading: Black Division
sections.text:
Black Division
The Black Division is TerraGroup's internal, highly trained special operations force.
